meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 它会从 channels 分支把 Google Chat 适配器和注册测试复制到 src/channels/,追加一行 import,安装 @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0,并把服务账号凭据写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你要为 NanoClaw 添加 Google Chat 渠道集成时触发;原文没有写显式的触发词。

say.text: 帮我把 Google Chat 渠道集成到这个项目里
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 这是我 Google Cloud 的服务账号 JSON,帮我填进配置
say.note: 以单行写入 .env 的 GCHAT_CREDENTIALS

say.text: 跑一下 gchat 注册测试,看看适配器还在不在
say.note: 红则说明 import 行或依赖已漂移

howto.what_en: It copies the Google Chat adapter and its registration test from the channels branch into src/channels/, appends one import line, installs @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0, then builds and runs the registration test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Google Chat channel support to NanoClaw; the skill lists no explicit trigger keywords.

say_en.text: Add the Google Chat channel integration to this project
say_en.note: copies the adapter, installs deps, runs the test

say_en.text: Here's my Google Cloud service account JSON, put it in the config
say_en.note: written as one line to GCHAT_CREDENTIALS in .env

say_en.text: Run the gchat registration test to check the adapter
say_en.note: red means the import or dependency drifted
